create_class_nougat_image_processor: create a NougatImageProcessor instance to preprocess images for the Nougat document-to-text model
run_preprocess_images: run the preprocess method on a list of images to crop margins, resize, pad, rescale, and normalize them
crop_margin_from_image: crop the gray margins from a torch.Tensor image using a configurable gray threshold
align_long_axis_image: align the long axis of an image tensor to match the longest axis of a target size by rotating 90 degrees
resize_image_thumbnail: resize an image tensor to fit within target dimensions while preserving aspect ratio using bicubic interpolation
